layout.headline: People and AI agents manage the same projects
layout.pointGrowTitle: Issues, schedules and time in one place
layout.pointGrowBody: Projects, issues, versions, Gantt charts, time tracking and wikis together.
layout.pointCiteBody: External agents such as Claude Code read and update issues under the same permission rules as people.
layout.pointSplitBody: Members, roles and permissions are managed per workspace.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.invitationNotice: To accept the invitation, sign in with the invited email's account. If you don't have one, sign up first.

signUp.title: Sign up
signUp.haveAccount: Already have an account? <cta>Sign in</cta>. Signing up creates your own workspace.
signUp.domainsOnly: Only {{domains}} email addresses can sign up.
signUp.emailHelp: We'll send a verification code to this address.
signUp.displayNameHelp: This is the name your colleagues see.
signUp.agree: I agree to the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy
signUp.pendingBody: You can sign in once a system administrator approves it.
signUp.invalidEmail: That isn't a valid email address.
signUp.agreeRequired: You need to accept the terms to sign up.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.description: Enter the 6-digit code from the email. The code is valid for 10 minutes.
verify.verified: Email verified. You can sign in now.
verify.approvalBody: You can sign in once a system administrator approves your account.

passwordReset.title: Forgot your password
passwordReset.description: Enter the email you signed up with. If there is an account for it, we email a 6-digit code to set a new password.
passwordReset.confirmDescription: If there is an account for {{email}}, we sent it a 6-digit code. The code is valid for 10 minutes.
passwordReset.noMail: No email? Check the address and get a new code. A new code replaces the previous one.
passwordReset.codeRequired: Enter the 6-digit code from the email.
passwordReset.resent: We sent a new code. It only arrives if there is an account.
passwordReset.done: Your password is set. Sign in with the new password. All other sign-ins were ended.
passwordReset.invalidCode: The code is wrong or expired. Check it or get a new one.
